title: This Weekend in Des Moines: October 2-4, 2026
content:
**Published Thursday, October 1, 2026.** This list is built from the 37 events on the Des Moines Insider calendar for Friday, October 2 through Sunday, October 4. Times, prices and venues are copied from each event's listing; when a listing has no confirmed start time we leave it off. Plans change, so check the event page or the venue before you go.

For the live list, updated every day, see [events this weekend in Des Moines](/events/this-weekend).

## Top picks

1. [Clint Black](/events/clint-black-2026-10-02) - Friday, October 2, 7:30 pm - Vibrant Music Hall (Music)
2. [Reefer Madness - Des Moines](/events/reefer-madness-des-moines-2026-10-02) - Friday, October 2, 7:30 pm - Stoner Theater at Des Moines Performing Arts (Arts)
3. [West Virginia Mountaineers at Iowa State Cyclones Football](/events/west-virginia-mountaineers-at-iowa-state-cyclones-football-2026-10-03) - Saturday, October 3 - MidAmerican Energy Field at Jack Trice Stadium (Sports)
4. [Alysha Brilla: Live at the Temple](/events/alysha-brilla-live-at-the-temple-2026-10-02) - Friday, October 2 - Temple Theater (Music)
5. [Come From Away](/events/come-from-away-2026-10-02) - Friday, October 2 - Des Moines Community Playhouse (Arts)
6. [Farmstasia 2026](/events/farmstasia-2026-2026-10-02) - Friday, October 2 - Living History Farms (Community)
7. [Lauren Alaina with Shane Profitt](/events/lauren-alaina-with-shane-profitt-2026-10-02) - Friday, October 2, 7:30 pm - Hoyt Sherman Place (Music)
8. [Dayton Flyers at Drake Bulldogs Football](/events/dayton-flyers-at-drake-bulldogs-football-2026-10-03) - Saturday, October 3 - Drake Stadium (Sports)

## Free events

No listing on our calendar for October 2-4, 2026 gives its price as free. Most list "See website", so a free event can still be hiding in the list below. Our [free events page](/events/free) has the ones we know about.

## How we picked

Top picks follow a fixed order: events an editor has marked featured, then shows at the metro's big ticketed venues (arenas, theaters, concert halls, stadiums, Living History Farms, the zoo), then festivals and family events, then everything else. Ties go to the more popular listing, then the earlier start. We take at most one pick per venue and three per category. Weekly regulars and online-only events are left out. When the same event is listed twice, it appears once.
